_comment: Passive creature abilities. Each has a machine-readable `kind` the battle engine interprets, so new abilities of a known kind are pure data. Kinds: pinch_boost {moveType,factor} — ×factor to the user's moves of moveType when its HP <= 1/3; guts — ×1.5 Attack while statused (and ignores burn's Attack drop); status_immunity {status} — can't get that status (poison covers toxic); contact_status {status,chance} — a physical hit on the holder may inflict status on the attacker; type_immunity {type} — takes no damage from that move type; sturdy — survives a full-HP OHKO with 1 HP. Assign one per creature via the Creature Editor. More kinds can be added in battle.js.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.desc: Powers up Fire moves when HP is low.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.desc: Powers up Water moves when HP is low.

overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.desc: Powers up Grass moves when HP is low.

guts.name: Guts
guts.desc: Raises Attack when afflicted by a status condition.

static.name: Static
static.desc: Contact with this creature may paralyze the attacker.

flame_body.name: Flame Body
flame_body.desc: Contact with this creature may burn the attacker.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.desc: Cannot be knocked out in one hit from full HP.
